policy_rationale: The gate averages four drift-free paired round estimates (each balanced sum/2 from opposite-order round pairs d0+d1, d2+d3, d4+d5, d6+d7) into effect_ns and forms t = effect/(sd/2) with n-1=3; it fails only when a drift-free positive effect exceeds 2% of the baseline median (min_relative_effect 0.02) as well as the Bonferroni-calibrated t threshold (t >= t_critical_df3 where P[T3 >= t] <= 0.05/18). Magnitude matters (a small consistent shift gives a small t) and monotone runner drift cancels in each opposite-order sum, so unchanged paths are not failed by noise that moves both sides together; sub-2% shifts (including curvature residuals and sub-percent effects) are treated as runner noise, so zero variance on a tiny effect does not fail, while a consistent 10% regression still fails. The pooled median delta is reported for audit, not gated.
